missable_note: Only one trophy may be missable: Positive Mental Attitude. Its Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it when it comes up and the risk is gone. Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story, and no 100% checklist item is missable. Sources: PowerPyx roadmap, SixShore trophy list.

stages.body: Finish Chapters 1–5 in order. Every story trophy pops automatically — none can be missed. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (15 manual slots). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude while you are there: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.body: Optional questlines unlock as the story progresses and all stay available after the credits — quest givers who vanish mid-story come back. Finish each character's final mission: Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason-only labs), Bret (Jason-only hunts) and Cal's fishing line. For Strangers & Freaks, note that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do.
stages.title: Character questlines & strangers
stages.trophies: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal + 8 Strangers & Freaks strands

stages.body: Scan everything with the WAiNK app as you travel — vehicles, landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags all feed three different trophies at once. Meditate at all 18 spots with both characters, complete any 3 card sets, and unfog the whole map by plane so the remaining hunts are visible. The 100% checklist only needs 200 of 277 vehicles and 15 of 18 meditations, but the trophies want the full counts where stated.
stages.title: Collectibles & exploration
stages.trophies: Meditations 18 · Card sets 3 · WAiNK scans 100 · Vehicles 100 · Unfog Leonida

stages.body: The long grind, best done after the story with both characters free. Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win a drone race at each of 14 locations and 20 different races, clear 250 stunts (under-bridge flights are fastest), rob a vault at 5 of the 8 banks, hit one illegal operation per gang, and let the money trophies ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations) fill up as you go. Bring your partner for Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
stages.title: Activities, races & robberies
stages.trophies: Stunts 250 · Shooting Range golds 42 · Drone races 14 · Races 20 · Vaults 5/8 · Gang ops 9 gangs

stages.body: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and all 15 Target Decks. Nothing on it is missable. Finish it and A Long Road pops.
stages.title: 100% completion & cleanup

stages.body: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. All single-player, one playthrough, no difficulty trophies, no DLC. PowerPyx rates it 4/10 difficulty — long, not hard.
stages.title: Platinum
